hook.name: ReflectionV4Hook
hook.description: Reflection-fee hook: buys collect 1.7% ETH into a buyback pot; sells send 1.7% of token input to the token via notifyReflection(). Every 20 swaps a buyback is queued, run by a manual buybackAndReflect() call. One liquidity add per token; only exact-input swaps supported. afterSwap gates sells: anyone can call excludeFromReflections() to set reflectionBase[token], after which only canReflect addresses (managed by genesisAddress) can sell; only genesisAddress can disable it.
